definition: to make a film or photograph of something
description: A woman in a beige parka works her way around an old Italian city taking pictures. She first holds up a small white compact camera in front of a pavement flower stall stacked with buckets of tulips and roses. She then stands in a cobbled street below a stone tower with a black DSLR pressed to her face, taking shot after shot. In the last part she is up on a brick rooftop terrace behind a giant telephoto lens on a tripod, aiming it out over a sea of tiled roofs, then turning to the camera with a delighted laugh.

de.answer: Sie fotografiert die Dächer mit einem riesigen Objektiv.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está fotografiando los tejados con un objetivo enorme.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle photographie les toits avec un énorme objectif.
